description.en: The ID of the instance. You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~473778~~) operation to query the ID of the instance.

description.zh: 实例所属地域的ID，您可以调用[DescribeInstanceAttribute](~~473779~~)接口查询。
description.en: The region ID of the instance. You can call the [DescribeInstanceAttribute](~~473779~~) operation to query the region ID of the instance.

descriptions.zh: 调用本接口时，实例必须已开启审计日志开关，详情请参见[ModifyAuditLogConfig](~~473829~~)或[审计日志](~~102015~~)。
descriptions.en: Before you call this operation, you must enable the audit log feature for the instance. For more information, see [ModifyAuditLogConfig](~~473829~~) or [Enable the audit log feature](~~102015~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun r-kvstore describe-audit-log-config --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000 --region cn-hangzhou
